title: Model Terms as Objects for Formula-Based Modeling
Model Terms as Objects for Formula-Based Modeling
text: Every built term carries design block, coefficient names, blueprint reproduces mapping new data; penalized terms carry penalties7 object, whose hyperparameters, derivatives kink set model layer reads. check_term() validates term data frame, edf() computes effective degrees freedom pieces fit supplies.
code: library(modelterms7)  dd <- data.frame(y = rnorm(50), x1 = rnorm(50), x2 = rnorm(50),                  g = factor(sample(letters[1:5], 50, TRUE))) dd$L <- matrix(rnorm(50 * 3), 50, 3)  out <- interpret_formula(y ~ x1 + log(abs(x2)) + lasso(L) +                            random(~ 1 | g), dd) names(out$terms)  built <- lapply(out$terms, term_build, data = dd) sapply(built, term_npar) sapply(built, term_smooth)

title: Effective Degrees of Freedom of a Term — edf
text: effective degrees freedom built term, computed pieces fitted model supplies. counting rule follows term's penalty. unpenalized term counts coefficients exactly. term smooth penalty uses trace \((H + S)^{-1} H\) block, \(H\) term's unpenalized curvature (weighted crossproduct design block fit) \(S\) penalty's Hessian coefficients estimated hyperparameters; without penalty trace reduces coefficient count, penalty grows falls toward penalty's null space. term non-smooth penalty counts nonzero coefficients, lasso unbiased estimator degrees freedom [Zou, Hastie & Tibshirani (2007)].
